node.statement: Smooth-polar antecedent: lem-stage1-polar-retraction supplies Pi_delta on the stated domain as a bijective C^1 diffeomorphism onto the open set S_delta, hence in particular as a bijective C^1 local diffeomorphism. Combining this with the smooth embedded atlas from node 1.5.1 satisfies lem-stage1-smooth-polar-inverse. Consequently the same Pi_delta and the same set-theoretic inverse (u_delta,h_delta) identified in node 1.3 are smooth, with no point or first derivative changed.
